description: Generate the printable receipt PDF for one transaction. Pass the transaction id from mhlb_list_transactions; the server fetches that transaction’s detail record and has the endpoint render it, so the receipt always reflects the account’s real data.

inline.description: Return the PDF as base64 in the result instead of writing it to a file. Default false.

isCreditType.description: Render as a credit rather than a payment. Default false.

name: mhlb_print_transaction
